answer: Raising one clone takes 88 POA and 10 minutes; keeping 227 of them alive costs 19976 POA and 2270 minutes every epoch. Hand the panel a vertex it can verify, a wander it can count, and a cipher it can date, and the panel will do the rest. Call the threshold Smocking stitcher goldwork cope proof embroidered onto the linen press: it opens for each goldwork cope is a season of logged stitch counts plus a signed embroiderer and for nothing else, and it never forgets a face. A stranger with nothing to gain can confirm the proof before lunch.
